## Data Import {.code-slide}

```r
library(readr)

p <- read_csv("data/raw/policies.csv")
c <- read_csv("data/raw/claims.csv")

glimpse(p)
```

::: {.code-note}
Start by making the data visible.
:::

## Join Policies And Claims {.code-slide}

```r
portfolio <- c |>
  left_join(p, by = "policy_id") |>
  count(product, claim_type)
```

::: {.join-diagram}
Policies

Claims

Portfolio view
:::
